name: Multan urban high-occupancy bus routes (Master Plan, c.2008-2012)
operator: Private operators on RTA routes (franchise scheme of the Regional Transport Authority)
notes: The plan lists these 3 as the urban high-occupancy bus routes 'presently operative' (survey c.2008-2012). It also says the RTA franchise scheme identified 6 routes needing 121 buses, and a 2005 UET study for the Transport Department proposed 8 bus routes (143 buses) and 12 wagon routes (505 wagons); none of these are listed. Fig 12.6 (p.12-22) maps existing bus and wagon routes without names. Marked historical: the corridors are now served by the Metrobus, MFR feeders and green e-buses.

routes.name: Dera Adda - General Bus Stand

sources.title: Integrated Master Plan for Multan (2008-2028), Master Plan Report Vol-2, Ch.12 Traffic and Transportation, section 12.3.4, report page 12-23 (PDF page 37)

routes.notes: Urban bus route. Listed in the NESPAK Integrated Master Plan for Multan (report dated May 2012, plan period 2008-2028), PDF page 37 (report p.12-23), as 'Dera Adda to General Bus Stand (via Kalma Chowk, MDA Chowk, Chungi No. 8 & 9, LMQ Road, Jinnah Chowk)'. Stops = named points in printed order; not a formal stop list. LMQ Road (a road) left out of the stops.
